category: SEC Football — It Just Means More
rationale: The response forcefully defends the SEC without conceding Big Ten superiority, citing decade-long national titles, NFL draft dominance, and road scheduling to rebut playoff results — matching the rubric's required depth and tone. quote: We’re talking about a conference that has won seven of the last nine national titles and produced more first-round NFL draft picks than your entire conference combined.
